svg.aria-label: A drawing of four old habits on the left, each with an arrow to the deliberate version on the right. The desk told us when we were working, becomes choose where real work happens. Getting tired told us when to stop, becomes pick a stop time before the evening. Colleagues were there by necessity, becomes keep people in the loop on purpose. Money was scarce enough to think about, becomes review the whole list each quarter.
svg.text: the old limits were doing a job
not going back. just putting the limits back on purpose.
